translation: Hua Boren said: The Ren and Du two vessels have one source but two branches; one runs in front of the body and one runs behind the body. The presence of Ren and Du in the human body is like the presence of zi (north) and wu (south) in heaven and earth; they can be separated and can be united. Separating them shows that yin and yang do not depart; uniting them shows that the undifferentiated whole has no gap; they are one yet two, and two yet one. Li Binhu said: The Ren and Du two vessels are the zi and wu of the human body. They are the pathway of the ascent and descent of the yang fire and yin talisman of the alchemists, and the place of intercourse of kan water and li fire.
